scope: 仅含数据的本地扩展包；刻意不包含检索实验与坏例分析。
upstream_lineage: Amazon 5-core LLO test split available locally
organizer frozen 50,000-product catalog and public 200 sessions
local candidate universe: catalog products that appear as LLO test targets
exclude 200 public target products, yielding 3,021 local extension targets
generate one deterministic public-schema-compatible session per remaining target
attach a separate positive-unlabeled selection-likelihood tier by parent_asin
construction_steps: Scan 2,524,981 test rows for ratings associated with catalog target parent_asin values.
Remove the 200 parent_asin values exposed by the public set; retain 3,021 unique targets.
Use seed 20260828 to assign public-proportional scenario types and observed difficulty mapping.
缩放公开 average_prior_rating 的边际分布，并为每个目标分配该目标在 LLO test 中出现过的单次互动评分代理；这不是用户历史平均分的复原。
设置公开可观察常量 category_bucket 与 purchase_frequency；由代理评分导出 rating_style。
真实用户、历史评分序列和标签算法不可得；preference_tags 显式留空，summary 标记 unavailable，而不是伪造用户画像。
Run the unmodified evaluator materializer on every generated session.
Attach product-level consensus tiers without changing the official session schema.

quality_tier_method.method: 在公开覆盖较强的合理商品筛选规则之间计算跨模型入选频率共识。最终共识使用商品评论量、test 交互量、历史长度、历史长度≥13 覆盖量和 metadata 完整度。
quality_tier_method.rating_boundary: 商品 average_rating 不参与最终四层共识；用户 average_prior_rating 从未进入分层；test 单次 rating 也未进入最终共识。
quality_tier_method.not_a_label: 层级不证明 private-800 成员身份，low_likelihood 也不是负例标签。

tiers.recommended_use: 敏感性验证；不是 private 标签
长尾压力测试；绝不当作 private 负例
